event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off; metals and semis sold hard.
Sept flash PMIs (mfg 57 vs 53.6 fc, services 58.7 vs 56 fc) plus Dallas Fed 9.8 vs 8.2 kept hike odds at 100% for Oct 28, driving TLT -0.88% and gold -3.94%. Money hid in healthcare and staples; cyclicals and comms bled.

INDICES — VIX 16.1, VIXY +1.08%.
RSP -0.65%, DIA -0.67%, IWM -0.69%, SPY -0.74%, QQQ -1.07%, SOXX -2.08%. Small beat large by 0.07pp. Biggest cross-asset move: SLV -5.49%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Elevation where it hurts.
SPY vol 1.0x, QQQ not listed — index-wide apathy even on a down day, so this is drift, not dumping. IJH 2.0x is the standout, and GLD/SLV 1.4x with price down = distribution in metals. Breadth is the story: only 24% of S&P names above the 50-DMA, 43% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 165/333, up/down vol 0.41, 11 new highs vs 86 lows. Participation flatly diverges from the index-level calm — this is a narrow, deteriorating tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +0.33%, XLP Staples +0.27%, XLE Energy +0.10%, XLRE Real Estate -0.51%, XLU Utilities -0.66%, XLB Materials -0.66%, XLK Technology -0.89%, XLI Industrials -0.97%, XLF Financials -1.19%, XLY Discretionary -1.41%, XLC Comms -1.58%.
Top industries: USO +1.13%, XBI +1.02%; bottom: SILJ -5.54%, SLV -5.49%. Flows show XLY +$711mm (100th pct) and XLK +$147mm (60th) in, XLF -$2,305mm (0th) and XLV -$1,089mm (2nd) out — the ONLY inflow sector ranked worst today, a clear contrarian tell, while the day's best sector (healthcare) was sold. Money is exiting financials and discretionary leadership even as prices hold. Rotation state: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.05 = real protection demand; QQQ 0.75 = complacency.
Both skews positive (SPY +7.0%, QQQ +6.4%) — put premium bid. VIXEQ 39.5 vs VIX 16.1 is an extreme gap = stock-picker's rotation tape; MOVE 101.8 vs 83.0 MA20 flags bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar +0.28% crushing gold -3.94% and silver -5.49% is the cleanest chain; TLT -0.88% confirms yields as the pressure source, with oil +1.13% the sole winner. Next FOMC Oct 28; CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0%, while Polymarket prices 68% for a 25bp hike (+4pp in 5 days) vs 30% no change. Rising hike odds into a 16.1 VIX is the tension.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 52.9, Neutral.
QCOM -7.17%, BA -6.91% (vol 2.8x, "The Defense 7"), INTC -5.67% led decliners; NVDA +2.62% and PSKY +2.41% were the S&P's Monday gainers. Momentum extremes: XLV best, XLC worst; no vol spike showed accumulation. MDT +0.97% on 2.3x vol is the one green spike. Watch SOXX (-2.08%, 20d +10.26% — trend break risk), GLD (-3.94%, GEX flip 330 vs spot below), and MDT (2.3x vol divergence).
